tool_schemas.name: list-chapters
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of all Quran chapters (surahs) with localized names and metadata for the requested language; results are returned as a single unpaged collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `language` is missing or does not match the supported language tag format. Raises NOT_FOUND when the requested language is not available.

tool_schemas.name: GET-chapter
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single chapter (surah) by its `id`, localized to the requested language. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `language` is invalid or `id` is not a positive integer. Raises NOT_FOUND when the chapter id does not exist or the requested language is not available for that chapter.

tool_schemas.name: info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the localized Chapter Info (surah introduction/description) for the given `chapter_id` and `language`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `language` is invalid or `chapter_id` is not a positive integer. Raises NOT_FOUND when the chapter does not exist or no chapter info exists for the requested language.

tool_schemas.name: verses-by_chapter_number
tool_schemas.description: Lists verses (ayahs) for the given `chapter_number`, optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio; results are paged with `page` and `per_page`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `chapter_number` is missing/invalid, when paging parameters are invalid, or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the chapter does not exist, or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

tool_schemas.name: verses-by_page_number
tool_schemas.description: Lists all verses that appear on the given Madani Mushaf `page_number`, optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio; results are paged with `page` and `per_page`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `page_number` or paging parameters are invalid, or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the page number is out of range or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

tool_schemas.name: verses-by_juz_number
tool_schemas.description: Lists verses for the given `juz_number`, optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio; results are paged with `page` and `per_page`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `juz_number` or paging parameters are invalid, or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the juz number does not exist or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `hizb_number` or paging parameters are invalid, or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the hizb number does not exist or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

tool_schemas.name: verses-by_rub_el_hizb_number
tool_schemas.description: Lists verses for the given `rub_el_hizb_number`, optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio; results are returned as a single unpaged collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `rub_el_hizb_number` is missing/invalid or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the rub el hizb number does not exist or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

tool_schemas.name: verses-by_verse_key
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single verse identified by `verse_key` (chapter:verse), optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `verse_key` is missing or not in `chapter:verse` form, or when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the verse does not exist or when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

tool_schemas.name: random_verse
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single randomly selected verse, optionally enriched with words, translations, tafsirs, and verse-level audio. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when enrichment parameters (ids/field lists) are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when a requested translation/tafsir/recitation id does not exist.

word_fields.description: Comma separated list of word fields

translation_fields.description: Comma separated list of translation fields

fields.description: Comma separated list of ayah fields

tool_schemas.name: juzs
tool_schemas.description: Returns the complete list of Juz (1–30), including any localized fields when `language` is provided; this endpoint is not paginated and always returns the full collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is present but fails validation (e.g., not 2–10 chars or not matching `^[a-zA-Z-]+$`).

tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a full-text search for the required query `q` and returns a paginated result set using `page` (or `p`) and `size` (or `s`). If `language` is provided, results are boosted toward translations in that language without restricting matches to only that language. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `q` is missing or any provided pagination parameter is invalid/unparseable.

q.description: Search query, you can use *query* as well

size.description: Results per page. *s* is also valid parameter.

page.description: Page number, well for pagination. You can use *p* as well

language.description: ISO code of language, use this query params if you want to boost translations for specific language.

tool_schemas.name: translations
tool_schemas.description: Lists all available translation resources, optionally filtered/annotated by `language`; results are returned as a single unpaginated collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is provided but is invalid.

tool_schemas.name: translation-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for the translation identified by `translation_id` (e.g., name, language, and resource details). Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `translation_id` is missing or invalid. Raises `NOT_FOUND` when no translation exists for the given `translation_id`.

tool_schemas.name: tafsirs
tool_schemas.description: Lists all available tafsir resources, optionally filtered/annotated by `language`; results are returned as a single unpaginated collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is provided but is invalid.

tool_schemas.name: tafsir-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for the tafsir identified by `tafsir_id` (e.g., name, language, and resource details). Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `tafsir_id` is missing or invalid. Raises `NOT_FOUND` when no tafsir exists for the given `tafsir_id`.

tool_schemas.name: tafsir
tool_schemas.description: Returns tafsir content for the specified `tafsir_id`, scoped by exactly one selector (`chapter_number`, `juz_number`, `page_number`, `hizb_number`, `rub_el_hizb_number`, or `verse_key`), and optionally limited to specific comma-separated `fields`. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `tafsir_id` is missing, when the selector is missing or ambiguous (more than one selector provided), or when any selector value is invalid. Raises `NOT_FOUND` when the `tafsir_id` does not exist or the requested scope (e.g., verse_key or index) has no tafsir content for that tafsir.

tool_schemas.name: chapter-reciters
tool_schemas.description: Returns the catalog of chapter-based reciters, including localized reciter names when `language` is provided; results are returned as a single unpaginated collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is provided but is invalid.

language.description: Name of reciters in specific language

tool_schemas.name: recitation-styles
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of available recitation styles, including any localized fields when `language` is provided; results are returned as a single unpaginated collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is present but fails validation (e.g., not 2–10 chars or not matching `^[a-zA-Z-]+$`).

tool_schemas.name: languages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of supported languages (and optionally their localized names when `language` is provided); results are returned as a single unpaginated collection. Raises `BAD_REQUEST` when `language` is provided but is invalid.
